product_name: HS DIY 65 mm ducted brushless micro quad
objective: assemble a physically piloted, repairable, 1S indoor whoop with off-the-shelf interchangeable components; reuse salvage only when electrically/mechanically compatible
flight_controller_firmware: Betaflight on supported 1S 4-in-1 AIO; choose exact target/firmware by board revision
radio: ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz radio, paired to an ELRS 2.4 GHz receiver; check regional radio rules
sim_reference: upstream gym-pybullet-drones Crazyflie 2.x physical quad model, NOT an aerodynamically validated digital twin of this 65mm brushless kit

mechanical_electrical_contract.battery_connector: BT2.0 (must match FC harness and charger)
mechanical_electrical_contract.motor_model_class: 0802 class brushless outrunners; approx 19500KV 1S; exact mount and shaft must match
mechanical_electrical_contract.flight_controller_mounting_hole_pattern_: 26x26 in vendor reference assembly; confirm board revision and frame
mechanical_electrical_contract.esc_requirement: 4-in-1 1S ESC, per-channel continuous current adequate for selected motors; 5A reference, do not infer motor current from KV alone
mechanical_electrical_contract.rf_requirement: 2.4 GHz ExpressLRS receiver and transmitter with compatible major firmware and selected regional band
mechanical_electrical_contract.protocol_requirement: Betaflight firmware supported by exact board target; motor mapping, DShot, failsafe and gyro orientation verified props-off
mechanical_electrical_contract.first_flight_environment: clear indoor area with guards and no bystanders; no outdoor BVLOS/autonomous modes

bom.component: 65mm ducted whoop frame; BETAFPV Meteor65 or verified compatible open printed frame
bom.reuse: Re-use uncracked ducted donor frame after verifying all four motor mounts; no cracked repaired ducts near props

bom.component: BETAFPV 0802SE 19500KV or documented electrically equivalent 1S brushless motor set
must_match: three-phase brushless output, not two-wire brushed toy motors
motor mount pattern and connector or solder pads
bom.reuse: Only 3-wire brushless donor motors with same dimensions and tested no-load condition; 2-wire brushed motors require a DIFFERENT controller

bom.component: 1S AIO flight controller with 4 ESCs and serial ELRS 2.4 GHz receiver; BETAFPV F4 1S 5A Serial ELRS reference
bom.reuse: Re-use only if programmable firmware target, gyro and ESC rails verified; proprietary toy FC is not automatically compatible

bom.component: set of 4 x 31mm 3-blade props with 1mm shaft hub; correct CW/CCW pair
must_match: two matched CW and two matched CCW geometry
bom.reuse: Do not reuse props with cracks, dents, bent blades or hub damage

bom.component: 1S 300mAh LiHV/LiPo rated for whoop current, BT2.0 connector
bom.reuse: Prefer new verified packs; never charge or fly swollen, punctured, unknown-chemistry or severely aged salvaged cells

bom.component: purpose-built 1S BT2.0 charger rated for selected LiHV/LiPo pack
must_match: 1S battery chemistry and max terminal voltage
bom.reuse: Do not repurpose USB power or unsupported phone chargers as a lithium pack charger

bom.component: RadioMaster Pocket or existing RC transmitter specifically with built-in ELRS 2.4 GHz
must_match: transmitter RF module must be ELRS not CC2500/4-in-1-only
firmware major version and region compatible with AIO RX
bom.reuse: An existing ELRS 2.4 GHz transmitter can be reused; protocol-incompatible radios cannot bind

bom.component: manufacturer-compatible motor screws, AIO silicone dampers, canopy and battery retainer
must_match: screw length does not enter motor windings
no contact between carbon/metal parts and PCB components
bom.reuse: Can salvage non-damaged screws and grommets only after dimensional match

bom.component: optional C03 analog camera + compatible 5.8GHz VTX + licensed goggles
must_match: voltage supply and wiring according to actual AIO
bom.reuse: Optional only; first hovering can be performed within direct visual line of sight

assembly_steps.title: Dry-build mechanical assembly
assembly_steps.physical_act: Place four motors in frame, check no cracks; match screw threads, prop clearance and rotation freedom; leave propellers OFF.
assembly_steps.evidence: four close-up pictures of motor/frame/FC mounts

assembly_steps.title: Mount controller and route conductors
assembly_steps.physical_act: Secure 1S AIO on rubber damping hardware, align orientation arrow, mount battery retention; check no harness can contact prop disks.
assembly_steps.evidence: top and bottom wiring photos, FC target model and connector polarity

assembly_steps.title: Connect four brushless motors
assembly_steps.physical_act: Use exact AIO manufacturer motor pads/connectors, check continuity and insulation; no unverified brushed-to-brushless substitution.
assembly_steps.evidence: photographed motor map and all four phases

assembly_steps.title: Pair radio / configure actual firmware
assembly_steps.physical_act: Connect USB, identify Betaflight board target, configure serial ELRS/CRSF, verify four channel sticks and assigned arm/disarm; do not flash blind.
assembly_steps.evidence: receiver signal screenshot, target/version and channel response

assembly_steps.title: Props-off motor and failsafe checkout
assembly_steps.physical_act: REMOVE all props. With a safe charged pack, verify gyro orientation, motor numbering and spin direction with Betaflight guided procedure; unplug/turn off TX to confirm motors stop as specified.
assembly_steps.evidence: four motor direction outcomes, failsafe record, no props attached

assembly_steps.title: First guarded line-of-sight flight
assembly_steps.physical_act: Only after gates pass, fit correctly oriented undamaged props. In a clear indoor area away from people, arm with low throttle, briefly hover and land; disarm immediately on unexpected motion.
assembly_steps.evidence: full recorded takeoff, hover, landing, post-flight motor temp and battery inspection

safety: No current hardware or physical flight has been completed by HS. Disconnect battery, remove props during motor tests, observe local airspace/radio rules, use fire-safe LiPo handling and inspect every salvaged item before use.
